selected_model.selection_rule: Identify the highest development macro PR-AUC; retain configurations within one standard error of it; select the fewest predictors, then lowest predeclared model-complexity rank, then lowest fold PR-AUC SD. Fold 4 is not loaded or scored.

operating_threshold.selection_data: pooled out-of-fold predictions from development folds 0-3 only
operating_threshold.objective: maximize F2 = 5 * precision * recall / (4 * precision + recall), prioritizing recall while retaining a precision penalty; ties choose higher precision then higher threshold
operating_threshold.caveat: The threshold and its displayed OOF metrics are selected and assessed on the same development OOF predictions; this is a development operating point, not an unbiased final performance estimate.
